title: OpenAI signs letter of intent for SK hynix HBM memory for Stargate

sources.quote: SK hynix signed a Letter of Intent (LOI) with OpenAI to supply High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), for the construction of global AI data centers under the Stargate project.
SK hynix will establish a production system capable of promptly meeting OpenAI’s HBM demand for up to 900,000 DRAM wafers per month.

explain: OpenAI signed a non-binding letter of intent for SK hynix to supply high-bandwidth memory (the fast memory stacked next to AI chips) for its Stargate data centers. SK said OpenAI's demand could reach up to 900,000 DRAM wafers a month, but no price was given.
